notes.title: Banned and restricted list update
notes.notes:
Hi there Mages,

There has been a few changes lately.

First of all, an email has been sent to thank every backer from our latest Kickstarter campaign, giving them codes to redeem the new exclusive avatar: "Tide".

Second, we've updated the banned and restricted list to follow the current state of the physical game.

Thus, the following cards are Banned and/or restricted:
[list]
[*] Crimson ritual is now banned.
[*] Ignition is restricted to 2 copies instead of 1.
[/list] 

We think these changes will greatly help with deck diversity in the current ecosystem.

Following the ban of Crimson ritual, the Fire starting deck for new players will now contain 2 Rite of passage to make up for the lack of ritual.

Third, while the game is receiving less updates lately, we want to help players get more cards and discover more new strategies, so we're doubling the amount of Influence point you obtain from games played as well as the amount of Power you get from supporting the game.

We hope this boost in resources will help you create even more incredible decks.

We really thank you for your support Mages. Have fun on the game!

notes.title: Early access update
notes.notes:
[b]v0.7.3 - 12/12/2022[/b]

[h1]# Changelog:[/h1]

[h2]## Features[/h2]

- You may now cancel your match search during the queue.
- When the game is closed and launched again, if you were in a game and it’s still going, you’ll now be reconnected to the game right away.
- Changed the Protector interface to display the amount of damage being redirected.
- Protector: hovering a Permanent during the redirection interface will now preview the amount of HP they’ll have left.
- Azure Ring: you may now choose the type of Mana you want to lock from your reserve under a spell if you're a Mage Noir.
- We now have a new target selection arrow
- Upgraded the timer visuals
- Upgraded card highlights visuals
- Upgraded card readability

[h2]## Bugfix :[/h2]

- Fixed a bug preventing players from removing Black & Gold cards from their decks.
- Fixed a bug hiding card costs once they were added to the deck during deckbuilding.
- Improved the button allowing you to filter owned cards in the deckbuilder.
- Fixed a bug allowing you to not take a card during Sprouted seed and Druid horns effects.
- Fixed a bug hiding the discard interface during the end of the turn, resulting in a softlock.
- Unleashed Ocean: fixed a bug with Prodigious source. The Permanent would make the cards too big in the Ocean’s interface, preventing players from finishing the effect selection and resulting in a softlock.
- Condensation: Fixed a bug that could happen during the effect’s auto-resolve at the end of the turn.
- Fixed a bug during the opponent’s Mana selection. The amount of Mana displayed could be inaccurate.
- Ritual of Mélange: Fixed a bug where the amount of Mana displayed in the player’s reserve would be inaccurate after trading Mana with its ability.
- Tide: The spell’s effects now occur in the right order.
- Fixed a bug that could enable / disable fullscreen when a game was loading.
- Enabling or disabling fullscreen with the (ALT + ENTER) keyboard shortcut will now update your game’s parameters automatically.
- fixed a bug putting the wrong amount of Mana in the Available Ether when a player reconnected during their Mana selection phase.
- Emptiness ritual: Fixed a bug displaying 2 selection arrows when it was used by an AI.
- Fixed some loading bugs when reconnecting in some cases.
- High pressure’s VFX is now displayed properly.
- The “cancel” button on the “ritual of Mélange” is now properly translated in english.

[list]
[*] Prepared spells could disappear completely in certain circumstances, that should no longer be the case.

[*] “Unleashed Ocean” now properly displays the amount of Mana it has after applying its effects.
[*] “Subtle infiltration” now functions properly if it locks something else than only water Mana.
[*] You can no longer release more Mana than intended with “Subtle infiltration”
[*] Corrected the zone detecting if you're hovering cards on the board.
[/list]

notes.title: Visual rework of the in game interface.
notes.notes:
Hey Mages! You will quickly notice that this update is bigger than usual.
Following your returns on the game and thanks to what we’ve been able to see thanks to you, we concluded that our in-game interface was functional, but not optimal.
We took the time to collect your feedback, do some (a lot) of research, and come back with this whole rework of the in-game interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684175/33812b64d6000d74b6578a2856219b3066a27f01.png[/img]

We sincerely think that all these changes are what’s best for Mage Noir - Infinity and that they will make the game truly shine.
thanks to this revamp, you’ll get:
[list]
[*] An easier time following Mana across the board
[*] A clearer board
[*] Easier to follow animation
[*] Prettier interfaces
[*] More explicit feedback
[/list]
In short, this update is a huge leap in Mage Noir - Infinity’s readability and playability!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684175/eba4fa80e5b39e8cb3c086be77684a7d6526849a.png[/img]

This visual update may require you to have a couple of games to get used to it, but we are confident you’ll adopt it very quickly. And it will be easier for new players to learn how to play.
We’re eager to know what you think of it.
Meanwhile, we wish you a wonderful day Mages, and have fun!

[b]~ The Mage Noir Team[/b]

[b]v0.7.0 - 08/11/2022[/b]

[b]# Changelog :[/b]
[b]## Big visual update[/b]
- Global graphic revamp of the game, to take your feedbacks into account including : 
[list]
[*] 	- Mana selection & Mana release revamp 
[*] 	- The card zoom when hovering a spell on the board have been revamped 
[*] 	- New visualization of the deck and the discard pile 
[*] 	- New board, new timer, new game areas… 
[*] 	- We added some shades on the board 
[*] 	- The interface for the player’s Mana reserve and their general info has been revamped
[/list]
- Your Mana count will now change color when a choice is about to increase your available pool 
- Effects from spells influencing the Mana you need to distribute during the Mana gathering phase will now be displayed. (Such as in Ritual of Mélange or Druid ring) 
- "Tide", "Condensation", "Breath", "Subtle Infiltration", "Sprouted seed", "Druid horns", "Fire Mask", "Unleashed Ocean" : their effects interface have been revamped
- An icon now shows the amount of Mana locked by a card on the board
- Tutorial tweaks to match the new interface. 
- We changed the font used in the cards texts to make it easier to read.

[b]## Bugfix:[/b]
- The effect of "Prodigious sowing" should now occur properly on all situations
- If a spell would go back in your deck during its activation, it will now discard properly at the end of its effects (as written in the game’s rules). For instance, this will happen if “Whirling wind" targets itself.
- Each instance of damages from "Emptiness Ritual" can now be redirected to different protector cards, as it should.  
- Armor equipment now apply their bonuses directly when they come into play. Armor will now be instantly removed if the equipment leaves the board.
- "Unleashed Ocean" : If you run out of time while choosing the order in which you apply your waves, the card used to release all its Mana. Not anymore. Also, the activated waves are also not discarded anymore.
- "Unleashed Ocean" : If you run out of time while choosing the order in which you apply your waves, your components doubled by “Prodigious source” are properly activated twice.
- We solved a number of other issues happening when the turn timer was up. 
- "Ignition" : The effect now lasts a single turn, as intended, and will not be active during your opponent’s turn 
- "Ignition" : The effect was sometimes active when the spell was only prepared, it is no longer the case. 
- When your timer is up, if your opponent must complete an action (for example activating a “Crimson Ring”) they can now do it in a short amount of time. The action was completed automatically before. 
- There should no longer be a game softlock if a player loses their internet connexion and reconnects 
- The order of the cards in the discard pile have been reversed, now the card on top of the pile is the first card on the list
- "The Water Healer" : There will no longer be a softlock when this card brings an “Ignition” back
- "Typhoon" : the effects are now properly applied in the order specified on the card 
- "Tornado" : When the AI chose to activate a “Favorable Winds”, the spell was not sent back to its deck. It should work fine now.
- "fire mask" : the AI now properly applies the cost reduction for its spell components 
- Breath & Subtle Infiltration: Correction of a game softlock when the turn timer came to an end during the spell effect.
- Activating “Droplet” will not softlock the game anymore.
- The AI now remembers the rules when activating “Emptiness Ritual” and its opponent chooses to redirect the damage to one of their protectors
- We corrected a bug on the displayed text while checking the discard pile.
- The Mana feedback when activating a card from your hand now works properly.

[b]## Known issue : [/b]
When preparing a “Tree in Flames” with a “Flame” component, the card will stay inactive on the board or will be returned to player’s hand, while the opponent won’t see it

notes.title: Early access update - Bugfix and QoL upgrades
notes.notes:
[b]v0.6.6 - 13/10/2022[/b]

[h1]# Changelog:[/h1]
[h2]## Features:[/h2]
- In Game: We removed cards names from the miniatures on the board, as they were too hard to read
- In-Game: “Rain of Flames”, “Subtle Infiltration” and “Wand of Air Currents” now have proper spell graphic effects
- In-Game: We added a highlight and a glimmer on cards you can interact with on the board
- Menu: We optimised the text placement for a better look and feel 
- Menu: Horizontal lists should now be scrolled on more naturally 

[h2]## Bugs fixes:[/h2]
- We updated the graphic library used for Infinity, to solve a strange issue where some players had a pink interface 
- “Unleashed Ocean”: Good news Water Mages ! We solved a bug preventing this spell to apply its effects at the beginning of a turn. There should be no more blocked matches because of it. 
- “Mist Breath”: You can now properly conclude this card effect even if you have less than three cards in your discarded pile
- “Tide”: You can now play this card even if you don’t have any other cards in hand
- “Tide”: If you discard another “Tide” with the first effect of this spell, you can now retrieve it with the second !
- We optimised the spell resolution system at the end of a turn to have a better management of component selection based effects (A burn from “Draconic Flame” triggering “Crimson Ring” for example)
- We also tweaked the end turn management system to better include cards adding mana for further turns (“Druid Ring” for example)
- We improved the quality of certain artworks in the collection screen (“Seed” for example)

[h2]## Known bugs:[/h2]
- Some interfaces specific to some cards (ie “Breath”) are unfinished and can be confusing (but are still working)
- “Emptiness Ritual” : Damages are displayed card per card but only trigger the protector effect of the opponent once

notes.title: Early access update - Bugfix and QoL upgrades
notes.notes:
[b]v0.6.5 - 06/10/2022[/b]

[h1]# Changelog:[/h1]
[h2]## Features:[/h2]
- When choosing your starting hand, the timer now disappears once you have made your choice 
- “Animated tree” / “Sprouted seed” : Every effect that asked you to pick a card from your deck and show it to your opponent will now show the card accordingly
- “Crimson ring” now has a VFX when dealing damages
- Shop : We added feedback to your wallet if you try to buy something but do not have enough money to pay for it
- We added a timer to the protector sequence to help both players better understand which player has to take action and for how long
- “Typhoon” : Small rework of the UI when selecting prepared spells to destroy

[h2]## Bug Fixes:[/h2]
- We fixed the flickering timer
- “Mental flame” : We fixed a bug that allowed the AI to get back some of the mana that was paid at the start of their turn
- “Fire ball” / “Fission” : A small bit of the discard UI (when preparing those cards) was not fully translated, we fixed it
- “Ephemeral brambles” : The AI now choses between both options instead of just not acting at all when facing this card
- The cast button of the rightmost spell is no longer in part hiding behind the player’s mana stash when a player has 5 prepared spells
- The cards in a player’s hand should now only be highlighted when playable
- “Subtle infiltration” : Fixed several bugs, mainly related to the way it was releasing its locked mana 
- “Kerloc’h’s Robe” : Your hand will now be correctly discarded while activating its ability.
- Targeted effects could be cancelled by clicking on “view more” arrows on the board. It is no longer the case.
- “Seed in the Wind” / “Animated Tree”: Sometimes the tree bringing back the seed at the beginning of a turn could cause a bug, not anymore!
- We optimized the way the game works with disconnection and reconnection to a match. 
- “Water Drop”: The temporary component is now properly affected by “Prodigious source”.
- “Great Waters / “Breath of flames”: The damage effect could target a permanent card without HPs, not anymore. 
- “Emptiness Ritual”: You can no longer play cards from your hand to get to 4 cards in hand. You have now to discard first!
- “Unleashed Ocean”: We changed the way this card triggers waves components.
- “Mental Flame”: The AI can now activate this card even if it produces no effect (instead of keeping it prepared for the whole game).

[h2]## Known bugs:[/h2]
- Visual bug: “Unleashed Ocean” displays a full mana release, however the mana sent back to the manapools reflect the correct number of waves used.
- “Wave echo” applies twice an effect of a targeted wave doubled due to Prodigious Source instead of once.
- Some interfaces specific to some cards (ie “Breath”) are unfinished and can be confusing (but are still working)
- “Emptiness Ritual” : Damages are displayed card per card but only trigger the protector effect of the opponent once

[b]v0.6.3 - 22/09/2022[/b]

[h1]# Changelog:[/h1]
[h2]## Features:[/h2]
- We added a little animated spark when you click on your screen 
- Menu - Settings - We added a “Credits” screen. 

[h2]## BugFixes:[/h2]
- We changed the effects order of activation at the start of a turn: now any armor will be refreshed before any offensive effect.
- “Ignition”: the effect will no longer be triggered by discarding cards from your hand
- In-game: It is no longer possible to duplicate mana during the mana release phase. 
- “Prodigious sowing” / “Seed in the wind”: we polished the way those cards are triggered to solve some problems when a card state changed (preparation, canalization, etc.) 
- “Air blade”: Can now be normally boosted (with the Howler Robe for example)
- “Tree in flames”: The loss of HP at the beginning of a turn can no longer be influenced by boosts (such as Druid ring for example)
- Mage Noir card costs reduction (Acceleration, Ignition, etc.): you can no longer have multiple ritual bonuses on cards newly drawn. 
- “Burning robe”: The card backlash can no longer be applied multiple times
- You can no longer keep a card flying above the board if you don’t choose a component before the end of the timer
- You can no longer play actions while a card is entering the game and applying its effects
- Starting deck selection: it is now possible to select a deck even if you closed the deck selection screen
- Menu, Deckbuilding: You can no longer add cards if you don’t own enough copies of it

[h2]## Known bugs:[/h2]
- Visual bug: “Unleashed Ocean” displays a full mana release, however the mana sent back to the manapools reflect the correct number of waves used.
- The size of your hand under “Emptiness Ritual” seems affected by the “Howler’s robe” but is not (it is purely a display bug)
- “Wave echo” applies twice an effect of a targeted wave doubled due to Prodigious Source instead of once.
- Some interfaces specific to some cards (ie “Breath”) are unfinished and can be confusing (but are still working)

This new version will make the onboarding smoother for new players.
Even if you are not a new player anymore, you should check the “Challenge” section for new rewards ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684175/24ec3644c2fd5e4e27457d6eca77eb414fde107e.jpg[/img]

[b]v0.6.0 - 01/09/2022[/b]

[h1]# Changelog:[/h1]

[h2]## Features:[/h2]
- The tutorial is now entirely optional.

- Menu: Corrected a softlock that could happen when changing your avatar.
- Mana trade: The trade button would sometimes disappear when both piles had the same amount of Mana. This should no longer be the case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684175/2fc171b13841fa946a040c9986c5524041b4fd3d.png[/img]

You asked for it, you were right, we dit it! This update brings two major features to Mage Noir - Infinity: elemental boosters to specialize your card collection, and duels with friends, to choose to whom you’ll teach a lesson!! 

[h2]1- Elemental booster packs[/h2]
For 25 Secrets, you can now specialize a booster pack in one of the 4 elements. 
The option will appear just before opening the booster pack: you will be able to open a "classic" booster pack as it was before, containing all the cards, or you can choose to add 25 Secrets to make the booster pack being of a single element. If you do so, the booster pack will contain 4 cards of this element, and some Secrets just like in classic booster packs.

[h2]2- Duels with friends[/h2]
You can now create games called “Duels” (protected by a password or not) to play against a friend (or against any player even if they are not your friend at all). 


[h1]# Changelog:[/h1]

- Added a lobby system (“Duels”) to play versus friends. (For quite obvious reasons these duels don’t give the bonus points of Influence for victory. They do give you the influence for the first games of the day though.)

- Added an estimated duration of the waiting for PVP games
- Increased the upper limit of Health Points of players and permanents

- Added many logs and improved our internal tools to facilitate the resolution of remaining bugs 


[h2]## Bugfix:[/h2]

- “Prodigious Sowing”: fixed a bug that prevent the display of choice at the beginning of turn
- Some buttons of the menu interfaces had a too large hitbox, it’s now fixed


[h2]## Known bugs :[/h2]
- Visual bug: “Unleashed Ocean” displays a full mana release, however the mana sent back to the manapools reflect the correct number of waves used.

## Bugfix :
- Losing or winning in the tutorial does not make you gain influence anymore
- After unlocking a regular card from the collection, the new price displayed was for a black and gold card. It's now fixed.
- Dropdown lists in settings have been fixed
- Setting volume now works
- In the main menu, "Settings" and "Bug report" buttons are now working correctly
- An action of the opponent sending a card to the discard pile sometimes blocked the game after the turn ended. This resolution should prevent quite a lot of issues that happened in the previous version
- Effects targeting the discard pile are now working 
- "Surging wave" now plays its sound FX correctly
- Clicking repeatedly on booster packs opening could cause visual bugs. It's now fixed. Cards acquired were correctly added to the collection. 

## Known issues (work in progress) :
- Permanents with "Protector" can sometimes freeze the game
- Sometimes when opening a booster pack, cards would not appear and you have to quit the game and start it again. Cards acquired are still added to your collection properly. 
- Some spells can let ghost cards appear on the board of the opponent
